scope: Support-first independent-flux rescue after the frozen NRCB2 PSF-star-count failure

sources.title: DOLPHOT JWST — Culling the catalog
sources.resultDate: living documentation; crawled as current on 2026-09-01
sources.supports: Defines source type, SNR, sharpness, crowding, and flag semantics and gives simultaneous F090W/F150W purity-oriented cuts, mostly pure to SNR 10. It does not guarantee isolated aperture support in NGC 3447.

sources.title: DOLPHOT JWST — Examining the logs
sources.resultDate: living documentation; crawled as current on 2026-09-01
sources.supports: Defines the per-frame columns and the desirable 100-star PSF/aperture diagnostics that RC71 preserved as failed.

sources.title: NIRCam Point Spread Functions
sources.supports: Reports an empirical F090W EE80 radius of 0.157 arcsec and a 0.031 arcsec short-wave pixel scale, motivating a 5.1-pixel aperture and 10.2-pixel non-overlap test.

sources.title: NIRCam Absolute Flux Calibration and Zeropoints
sources.resultDate: latest imaging calibration update reported as March 2026
sources.supports: CAL SCI arrays are MJy/sr; PHOTMJSR converts surface brightness to DN/s; PIXAR_SR and calibration factors vary by detector. The page also documents continuing calibration updates.

sources.title: Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse
sources.supports: Shows why repeated analyst access can overfit a holdout and motivates a controlled, one-use outcome boundary. It does not prove validity under astronomical spatial dependence.

sources.title: The JWST Resolved Stellar Populations Early Release Science Program V. DOLPHOT Stellar Photometry for NIRCam and NIRISS
sources.supports: Validates the JWST DOLPHOT modules in crowded-field applications; it does not validate the RC72 core integrator or NRCB1-to-NRCB2 transport.

sources.title: The Perfect Host: JWST Cepheid Observations in a Background-Free SN Ia Host Confirm No Bias in Hubble-Constant Measurements
sources.supports: NGC 3447 and the published distance-ladder context. It does not adjudicate detector-level PSF support or this raw-pixel diagnostic.

verifiedBeforePixelOpening: RC71's 91-96-star PSF failure and all downstream closed gates remain immutable.
The 16 CAL files required by the two-detector diagnostic match the RC69 MAST manifest hashes.
Catalogue support rules and their exploratory inspection were disclosed before CAL-pixel residuals were computed.
The coordinate-hash rule selected exactly eight stars in each 2x2 cell and detector for the core route.
verifiedByRC72: The large EE80 non-overlap route has inadequate support: NRCB1's minimum cell has four stars and NRCB2 has zero in every cell.
The core route had catalogue support but failed first at the NRCB1 control tail, with p90 absolute residuals 0.303 and 0.210 mag.
NRCB2 residuals therefore cannot be interpreted as detector transport error under this adjudicator.
Python measurement and Node decision implementations reproduce offsets, rows, summaries, and gates.
inferences: A global core-aperture offset is insufficient to absorb centering, undersampling, neighbor wings, and background structure across the NRCB1 tile.
A physics-based PSF or an externally qualified scene model is more informative than retuning the failed aperture on the retired holdout.
unverifiedProposals: Qualify WCS centering and the pixel integrator on isolated public calibration stars before returning to NGC 3447.
Use a fresh disjoint tile or a preregistered STPSF/scene-model adjudicator with explicit focus, jitter, and neighbor terms.

prizeReview: No active cash prize or official challenge award was found for these three problem records; RC72 adds no prize amount.
statusChangeReview: No cited source or RC72 result resolves the Hubble tension, finite-sample transport, or post-selection inference. RC72 narrows the validation path by rejecting two rescue routes for this tile.
